summary: Scribble.rs is a self-hosted, web-based drawing and guessing game that allows users to play Pictionary online with friends. It provides a real-time multiplayer environment where participants take turns sketching words while others guess them in a chat interface.
goodFor: It is a suitable choice for hosting private game nights or casual online gatherings for friends on your own infrastructure.
watchOut: The project shows signs of being at-risk with low maintenance activity, which could mean delayed security patches or unaddressed bugs over time.
deployNotes: As a Go application packaged for Docker, it typically requires a container runtime, persistent storage for any user data or custom word lists, and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
